patch_description: The current 3-parameter design (rz_pre, rz_post, ry_shared) introduced parameter bloat without accuracy gains, reducing the combined score from 0.72 to 0.68. The prior 2-parameter baseline (ry_shared, rz_shared) achieved the highest score because it provides optimal parameter economy while maintaining perfect accuracy. By reverting to the single-block 2-parameter structure, we eliminate unnecessary complexity, reduce parameter count from 20 to 14, improve parameter efficiency from 0.05 to 0.07, and restore the best-performing configuration. The single block offers better convergence and generalization than multi-block repetitions without sacrificing any accuracy.
